metadata.description: Agent skills for arpe.io high-performance data tools (FastBCP, FastTransfer, MigratorXpress, LakeXpress, ADBC drivers).

plugins.name: fastbcp
plugins.description: Build, explain and troubleshoot FastBCP commands: parallel bulk export from SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL and more to CSV/Parquet/JSON/Excel, locally or to S3, Azure, GCS and OneLake.

plugins.name: fasttransfer
plugins.description: Build, explain and troubleshoot FastTransfer commands: parallel bulk transfer between SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, ClickHouse, SAP HANA, Teradata, Netezza and DuckDB, and CSV/Parquet/JSON file imports.

plugins.name: migratorxpress
plugins.description: Build, explain and troubleshoot MigratorXpress migrations: credentials file (classic, connection string, trusted, ODBC), task lists, resume, schema and table selection, for Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and Netezza sources to SQL Server or PostgreSQL.

plugins.name: lakexpress
plugins.description: Build, explain and troubleshoot LakeXpress pipelines: credentials file, LakeXpress DB, sync configurations, incremental syncs and resume, exporting Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MariaDB, SAP HANA and Teradata tables to Parquet on local disk, S3, GCS, Azure or OneLake, and publishing them to Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, BigQuery, Redshift, MotherDuck, AWS Glue or DuckLake.

plugins.name: arpeio-adbc-drivers
plugins.description: Install, connect, query and bulk-load with the arpe.io ADBC drivers: ArpeMSSQL (SQL Server, Azure SQL, Fabric), ArpePGSQL (PostgreSQL), ArpeOracle (Oracle, Autonomous Database), ArpeNetezza (IBM Netezza) and ArpeTeradata (Teradata). Covers the installer, licence, options, connection strings and URIs, authentication, TLS, type mappings and ingest.
